1: The number 2^(-1) * 32^(3/5) is equal to: A. -16  B. -4  C. 2  D. 4. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
2: The number log_3(3/2) + log_3(2/9) is equal to: A. log_3(31/18)  B. log_3(5/11)  C. -1  D. 1/3. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
3: The number (2*sqrt(10) + sqrt(2))^2 is equal to: A. 22  B. 42  C. 42+4*sqrt(5)  D. 42+8*sqrt(5). Choose the correct answer from the options given.
4: Two rectangles are given: P1 with side lengths a and b, and P2 with side lengths 0.2a and 8b. The area of P1 is: A. 60%  B. 62.5%  C. 160%  D. 162.5% of the area of P2. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
6: The number of all positive integer solutions of the inequality (3x-5)/12 < 1/3 is equal to: A. 2  B. 3  C. 5  D. 6. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
8: One of the solutions of the equation (3x/(x-2))*(2x+8)=0 is the number: A. -8  B. -4  C. 2  D. 3. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
10: The number 2 is a zero of the linear function f(x) = (3-m)x+4. The number m is equal to: A. 0  B. 3  C. 4  D. 5. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
11: Figure 1 shows, in the coordinate system $(x,y)$, the graph of the function $f$. The greatest value of the function $f$ is equal to: A. $2$  B. $4$  C. $6$  D. $7$. Choose the correct answer.
15: The sequence (a_n) is given by a_n = 2*(-1)^(n+1)+5 for every natural number n>=1. The sum of the first ten consecutive terms of this sequence is equal to: A. 3  B. 7  C. 50  D. 100. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
16: In the arithmetic sequence (a_n), defined for every natural number n>=1, a_1=7 and a_2=13. The term a_10 is equal to: A. -47  B. 52  C. 61  D. 67. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
19: The right trapezoid ABCD has bases |AB|=8 and |CD|=5. The height AD of this trapezoid has length sqrt(3) (see figure: right angles at A and D). The measure of the acute angle ABC is: A. 15 degrees  B. 30 degrees  C. 45 degrees  D. 60 degrees. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
20: Points A, B and C lie on a circle centered at S. The length of arc AB, on which the inscribed angle ACB is subtended, equals 1/5 of the circle's circumference (see figure). The measure of the acute angle ACB is: A. 18 degrees  B. 30 degrees  C. 36 degrees  D. 72 degrees. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
21: The lines k and l are given by the equations k: y=(3m+1)x+2 and l: y=-4x+(2m+5). The lines k and l are parallel when the number m is equal to: A. -4  B. -5/3  C. -3/2  D. -1. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
23: The diagonal of a face of a cube has length 2*sqrt(2). The volume of this cube is: A. 8  B. 24  C. 16*sqrt(6)/9  D. 16*sqrt(2). Choose the correct answer from the options given.
24: The base of a regular quadrilateral prism is a square with side length 4. The solid diagonal of this prism is inclined to the base plane at an angle alpha such that tan(alpha)=2 (see figure). The height of this prism is: A. 2  B. 8  C. 8*sqrt(2)  D. 16*sqrt(2). Choose the correct answer from the options given.
25: A regular pyramid has 2024 lateral faces. The total number of edges of this pyramid is: A. 2025  B. 2026  C. 4048  D. 4052. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
26: A regular quadrilateral pyramid ABCDS has base ABCD with base edge length 4. The total surface area of this pyramid is 56. The height of the lateral face, drawn from apex S to the base edge AB, is: A. 3  B. 5/2  C. 21/2  D. 5. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
27: [Figure: bar chart of a math test's results in a class; grades 1-6 on the horizontal axis, with 2, 9, 5, 3, 5, 1 students respectively on the vertical axis.] The arithmetic mean of the grades obtained on this test by students of this class is: A. 3  B. 3.12  C. 3.5  D. 4.1(6). Choose the correct answer from the options given.
28: Consider all even four-digit natural numbers whose decimal representation uses only the digits 2, 4, 7 (e.g. 7272, 2222, 7244). The total number of such numbers is: A. 16  B. 27  C. 54  D. 81. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
29: A box contains only white and black balls. There are 18 black balls. One ball is drawn at random from this box. The probability of drawing a black ball is 3/5. The number of white balls in the box, before drawing one ball, was: A. 9  B. 12  C. 15  D. 30. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
33: The side of square ABCD has length 12. Point S is the midpoint of side BC. Point P lies on segment AS such that segment BP is perpendicular to segment AS. Calculate the length of segment BP.
34: The three-term sequence (4x^2-1, 2x^2+1, 1-x) is arithmetic. Calculate x.
35: A random experiment consists of rolling a fair six-sided die twice; the die has a different number of pips on each face, from one to six pips. Calculate the probability of event A: that the first roll shows a greater number of pips than the second roll.
36: In the coordinate plane (x,y), points A=(2,8) and B=(10,2) are given. The perpendicular bisector of segment AB intersects the x-axis at point P. Calculate the coordinates of point P and the perimeter of triangle ABP.
